# Leaving Batcher for Ray Data

This page maps Batcher spellings back to Ray Data, for code moving the other way. It lists only the rows whose status is canonical or alias, where both engines compute the same thing. A Batcher spelling that behaves differently in Ray Data isn't listed here, so look it up on the forward pages in {doc}`index` before porting it.

To rewrite Batcher code the other way, run the codemod in reverse:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from batcher --to ray_data <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction isn't implemented yet, so the command refuses it with a `ConfigError`. The implemented directions are `--from batcher --to batcher`. Until yours lands, port by hand with the tables on these pages.

## Batcher to Ray Data

The following table maps 102 Batcher spellings to the Ray Data names that compute the same thing, sorted by Batcher spelling. Each Ray Data name is prefixed with the class or module it lives on.
